blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pharmaceutical giant AstraZeneca is expanding its clinical trial footprint in the Philippines by tapping the Ayala Group’s health-care arm to identify and prepare additional hospitals where it can conduct research and test potential new treatments.
